revision_history.source: User request 2026-11-23: fixed-frequency transmons for the NCKU design (Design6 + Design7), keep 4 Q + 4 bare resonators, modify Design7 in place

user_decisions.decision: Keep Ec ~ 200 MHz (no pad enlargement); EJ/EC > 35 accepted for all qubits
user_decisions.noted_tradeoff: Q1 (3.5 GHz, EJ/EC 43.2) f01 charge dispersion 26.6 kHz peak-to-peak (scqubits); parity switching can appear as Ramsey beating

user_decisions.decision: Use the r2 SQUID-pocket Q3D (Ec 199.68 MHz, beta 0.07069) for r3 without a Q3D rerun; the single-leg change is judged negligible (expected < 1 % in C_sigma)
user_decisions.source: 使用者：不需要，這點差異很小
